# kaneo_user

Manages a Kaneo instance user. The provider must authenticate as an instance admin. Creating a user does not add them to any workspace. Do not manage the provider's own account with this resource; deleting that account is prohibited by Kaneo, and demoting it can prevent further administration.

## Example usage

```terraform
resource "kaneo_user" "alice" {
  email = "alice@example.com"
  name  = "Alice"
  role  = "user"
}
```

This creates no password credential. Social or OIDC account linking depends on server policy and email verification; unverified users are not automatically linked.

For password login, use Terraform 1.11 or later and an ephemeral source. See [password setup and rotation](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/glitchedmob/kaneo/latest/docs/guides/passwords) for an example and source-security rules.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) User email. Kaneo stores lowercase email. The provider preserves equivalent configured casing in state; import returns lowercase.
- `name` (String) Display name.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `email_verified` (Boolean) Whether the email is verified. Defaults to `false`. Set `true` only for an email you have independently verified. This can enable OIDC account linking depending on the server's settings; the resource does not configure OIDC.
- `password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Credential password, 8 to 128 bytes, never stored in Terraform plan, state, or private state. The provider sets it on creation or when the version changes. Requires Terraform 1.11 or later. Configure with password_wo_version; omit both to create without password login. Use an ephemeral input or ephemeral.random_password to avoid storing the source value. Removing both attributes stops management without removing the remote password.
- `password_wo_version` (Number) Positive integer recording the last successfully applied password version, stored in state. Configure with password_wo. Change this value to apply a new password; changing only password_wo or unrelated attributes does not reset it. Cannot be read or imported. Failed password changes retain the last successfully applied version.
- `role` (String) Instance role, `user` or `admin`. Defaults to `user`. This is not a workspace role.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) User identifier.

## Import

```shell
terraform import kaneo_user.alice user-id
```

## Limitations and recovery

Deletion removes the user, sessions, and accounts. Permission failures retain state; only a missing user is removed. Admin diagnostics omit response bodies to protect credentials.

Failed initial password setup retains the created user ID with no password version. Terraform may taint the user and propose replacement; review the plan before retrying. Failed rotation retains the last successful version so the next plan can retry.
